title: A week of every bus in Oakville
description:
A week of every bus in Oakville, Monday to Sunday, in 60 seconds.

Each day is the average of that weekday in October 2026, so Saturday is a typical Saturday, not one particular one. Vehicles outside the Oakville town limits are faded and not counted. Colours: Local, School and GO, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment: 69 buses, Monday at 7:40 am.
The daily averages use every October 2026 date in each timetable and leave out Thanksgiving (October 12). Burlington Transit has no October timetable, so it uses November 2 to 28. October 31 and November 1 are left out because the clocks change. GO Transit ran a reduced timetable on October 10 and 11, so those days are left out. GO Transit changed its timetables during October and has fewer than three usable October Saturdays and Sundays, so its Tuesday, Saturday and Sunday each use one typical date.
